rights.data_license_status: CC0 1.0 for each listed dataset, as published in the Dutch national data catalogue
rights.attribution: Source: RDW Open Data (Netherlands), CC0 1.0. Attribution is provided as a courtesy.
rights.evidence_summary: Each catalogue entry identifies RDW as data owner, public access and CC0 1.0. The TGK entries expose CSV, JSON and XML downloads. The product uses only the selected public datasets and does not include third-party websites or registration identifiers.

field_semantics.make_model: merk and handelsbenaming are NL registration-dataset labels. They support NL observed make/trade-name identity only, not model generation or worldwide market applicability.
field_semantics.type_approval: typegoedkeuringsnummer is the EU type-approval identifier. Variant, uitvoering and revision are preserved as separate exact raw fields.
field_semantics.engine_designation: motorcode is preserved exactly as RDW publishes it. Until independently corroborated against an OEM source, it is an RDW engine designation candidate, not a confirmed VAG factory engine code.
field_semantics.gearbox_classification: codetypeversnellingsbak is preserved exactly as RDW publishes it. It is an approval gearbox-type classification, not a VAG gearbox code.
field_semantics.model_year: datum_eerste_toelating is a first-registration date, not model year or production date. It must not populate model_year.
field_semantics.manufacturer_trade_name: handelsbenamingfabrikant and typeaanduidingfabrikant are approval/manufacturer trade-name fields, not generation identifiers.

applicability_policy.join_policy: Only associate a source row with the exact same approval number, variant, version and revision. Preserve raw values. The exact key identifies approval scope only.
applicability_policy.engine_gearbox_pairing: NEVER cross-join engine rows and gearbox rows. Separate child datasets do not establish an exact engine/gearbox pair, even when both contain the same approval-scope key. No pair table or pairing claim may be emitted.
applicability_policy.market_scope: NL registration observations and EU type-approval identifiers; not RU/EAEU.

project_decision: Rights-cleared for a separate NL/EU type-approval research pack after the live schema probe. No production fitment, no RU/EAEU applicability, no model-year inference, no VAG engine/gearbox-code assertion and no engine/gearbox pairing.
